notes: Zed's GPU-accelerated UI framework in Rust. It is GPU + UI, so it is said as four letters — G-P-U-I — not as a word. Do not say guh-POO-ee or gee-pwee. The crate docs gloss it as a GPU-accelerated UI framework, which is where the reading comes from; it trended the week of 2026-11-09 with the Blender-vs-GPUI write-up (738 points on HN).

Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting and Conformance — the email-auth standard behind the p=reject records everyone eventually has to add. Said as a word, DEE-mark, never spelled out D-M-A-R-C; the whole deliverability literature (dmarcian, the vendor playbooks) reads it that way. Trending 2026-11-09 after Outlook.com started rejecting mail from domains with no DMARC record.
